articles.title: At least 11 killed in Ukrainian and Russian strikes as holiday camp hit
articles.summary: Russian and Ukrainian drone strikes have killed at least 11 people in Ukraine, including children at a holiday camp located in a Russian-held eastern region. The overnight attacks underscore the severe human cost and ongoing intensity of the conflict, with civilians increasingly affected by the widespread use of drones in this prolonged war.

articles.title: The movie 'Border' inspired her, took different job to support family. Years later, she made history in Indian Army. Meet Major Prajakta Desai

articles.title: rust-analyzer-db added to PyPI
articles.summary: This professional Python tool leverages tree-sitter to analyze Rust source code. It extracts code entities, computes static metrics, and stores all data in a SQLite database. This enables efficient querying, searching, and call-graph generation for Rust projects, significantly aiding in code understanding and maintenance, crucial for robust software development.
